behaviors.description: Transaction option roundtrips and installation association.
expected: Boolean options roundtrip both ways; parent window accepts both protocols; installation path and profile match.

behaviors.description: Unique, remote-qualified, missing and ambiguous operation lookup.
expected: NULL remote finds unique ref, remote qualifier disambiguates duplicate ref, ambiguous and missing matches return NULL with GError.

behaviors.description: Execution order, empty skipped updates, and signal thread.
expected: Non-skipped resolved list matches execution; unchanged update resolves empty; callbacks run synchronously on run thread.

behaviors.description: Retained operations, installation, progress status and live cause graph.
expected: Owned results survive transaction destruction; borrowed cause graph is inspected only while transaction lives.

mappings.rationale: Compare owned installation path and user profile. Option roundtrips alone do not claim fixture-dependent option or authentication contracts.

Lookup queued uninstall with NULL remote, then add a reinstall from a different remote and verify each qualifier; NULL remote ambiguity and missing remote/ref must all return NULL with GError. Inspection preserves installed A.
Retained ready list pointer order equals new-operation order, no skipped elements; all-skipped update is empty. Every execution callback checks run thread and active run lifetime.

Owned installation and operation list inspected after releasing transaction; runtime cause identifies app while alive. Actual allocating status result retained across later callbacks and object release, compared to saved bytes and freed.
